description: This file defines data structures and function prototypes for a buffering queue system used in libcurl. It includes definitions for managing chunks of bytes, a pool of chunks, and a queue for reading and writing byte data, along with functions for initializing, resetting, reading, writing, and passing data through the buffer queue.

methods.name: Curl_bufcp_init
methods.description: Initialize a buffer chunk pool with a specified chunk size and maximum spare chunks.

methods.name: Curl_bufcp_free
methods.description: Free resources associated with a buffer chunk pool.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_init
methods.description: Initialize a buffer queue with specified chunk size and maximum chunks.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_init2
methods.description: Initialize a buffer queue with options.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_initp
methods.description: Initialize a buffer queue with a provided buffer pool.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_reset
methods.description: Reset a buffer queue to empty state.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_free
methods.description: Free all resources used by the buffer queue.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_len
methods.description: Return total bytes stored in the queue.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_space
methods.description: Return available free space in the queue.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_is_empty
methods.description: Check if queue is empty.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_is_full
methods.description: Check if queue is full.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_write
methods.description: Write data to the queue, copying the input buffer.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_cwrite
methods.description: Write data to the queue, with a different interface.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_read
methods.description: Read data from the queue, copying into buffer.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_cread
methods.description: Read data from the queue with a different interface.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_peek
methods.description: Peek at the current head chunk without modifying the queue.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_peek_at
methods.description: Peek at a specific offset within the current head chunk.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_skip
methods.description: Skip/discard a number of bytes from the start of the queue.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_pass
methods.description: Pass chunks to a writer callback, possibly writing directly.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_slurp
methods.description: Read data from a reader callback and append to the queue.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_sipn
methods.description: Read up to max_len bytes from a reader callback once.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_write_pass
methods.description: Write data to the queue, possibly passing directly to a writer callback.
